articles.title: Alcaraz Gets His Revenge to Win First Paris Masters Title
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Ben Shelton 7-6 (7-5), 7-5 to win his first Paris Masters title, just 60 days after Shelton ended his US Open comeback run.

articles.title: A One-Person Flying Machine Meets a Giant Rocket
articles.summary: A single-person electric aircraft called Jetson ONE flew at NASA's Kennedy Space Center, with Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket stage towering behind it.

articles.title: A Sci-Fi Novel Wins the Booker Prize for the First Time
articles.summary: M. John Harrison's The End of Everything is the first science fiction novel to win the Booker Prize, capping the author's 60-year career.
